# Bike Maintenance

Log for the grey gravel bike.

## Drivetrain

Replaced the chain at 3,200 km when the checker showed 0.5 percent stretch. The cassette was fine. Clean and lube the chain every 300 km, or after any wet ride.

## Tyres

Running 4.5 bar front and 4.8 bar rear on the 32 mm tyres. After the puncture on the [[Coast Path Ride]] I switched to tubeless sealant on the front.

## Brakes

New pads in August. The rear disc squeals in the rain; cleaning the rotor with isopropyl alcohol fixes it for a while.
